This document outlines the 
details equipment maintenance steps, required for burner mazout pumps this pump 
is used for supply the boiler with mazout. This inspection performed every two 
years as indicated by major maintenance (P1-Y2) in the above title block.

The first draft initiated 
by eng . Abdalla M. Abdalla. reviewed by director eng. Gamal Arafa and revised 
by quality control eng. Samir Abd EL-Gelil at edec, accepted by general director 
eng. M. Abd El-Salam and approved by eng. Michael Goerge. Head sector of Ayoun 
Moussa steam power station 2x320 MW.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS Coordinator and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman admin. and financial 
 inspection & quality control general director and supervisor of EDEPC 
 inspection and quality control head sector.

Technical specification of 
Burner Mazout Pumps

oil unloading pumps PUMPS

A 
 work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets shoes, gloves, etc
Isolate the circuit breaker for the motor of this pump
Isolate the electrical cable feeding of the motor of this pump
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery valve
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid, manual puller, Torque wrench
Suitable lifting device feeler gauge

Hammer,
 Dial indicator

Check the closing of the suction delivery. 
 Heating steam valves.
Let pump cool down to the ambient temperature.

Prepare tank for catching liquid drain from pump 
 by open plugs.

Dismount protection against accidental contact 
 from the base plate.

Screw off the bolts connected motor with 
 foundation and move motor faraway.

Remove coupling with removal device and remove 
 key (866) also.

Move pump vertical and remove pump casing (131) 
 upwards.

Mark position of idler spindle and (661) and 
 remove them.

Press main spindle (669) with ball bearing out of 
 flange cover (074)
Remove circlip (869) and spacer (063)
Press out ball bearing

Check flat gaskets and o-rings whether they are 
 damaged. If necessary clean and polish the running surface of the main spindle 
 in the range of the o-rings and seal lips

The coupling end should be covered with an 
 installation sleeve to protect the o-rings and the seal lips. For an easy 
 installation it is useful to grease the surface slightly

To dismantle the mechanical seal, remove the 
 slide ring and the spring from the main spindle by twisting it clockwise. 
 Press counter ring with a plastic sleeve out of the casing
Clean well every part of the pump

Assembly every part in reverse sequence of 
 disassembly

After finishing the assembly of the pump it must 
 be rotating by hand by hand from the coupling
Re-alignment of the pump to the motor

Re-grease the ball bearing from the lubricating 
 nipple

Safety Precautions
A 
 work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the

Isolate the electrical cable feeding of the motor of this pump
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery valve
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid, manual puller, Torque wrench
Suitable lifting device feeler gauge
Hammer,
 Dial indicator
Work to be Carried Out
Check the closing of the suction delivery. 
 Heating steam valves.
Let pump cool down to the ambient temperature.
Prepare tank for catching liquid drain from pump 
 by open plugs.
Dismount protection against accidental contact 
 from the base plate.
Screw off the bolts connected motor with 
 foundation and move motor faraway.
Remove coupling with removal device and remove 
 key (866) also.
Move pump vertical and remove pump casing (131) 
 upwards.
Mark position of idler spindle and (661) and 
 remove them.
Press main spindle (669) with ball bearing out of 
 flange cover (074)
Remove circlip (869) and spacer (063)
Press out ball bearing
Check flat gaskets and o-rings whether they are 
 damaged. If necessary clean and polish the running surface of the main spindle 
 in the range of the o-rings and seal lips
The coupling end should be covered with an 
 installation sleeve to protect the o-rings and the seal lips. For an easy 
 installation it is useful to grease the surface slightly
To dismantle the mechanical seal, remove the 
 slide ring and the spring from the main spindle by twisting it clockwise. 
 Press counter ring with a plastic sleeve out of the casing
Clean well every part of the pump
Assembly every part in reverse sequence of 
 disassembly
After finishing the assembly of the pump it must 
 be rotating by hand by hand from the coupling
Re-alignment of the pump to the motor
Re-grease the ball bearing from the lubricating 
 nipple
Trouble | Possible Reasons | Remedy
Pump does not prime and deliver | Prior to initial operation, the pump was not filled with 
 fluid to be pumped | Fill pump with fluid to be pumped
Stop valves / slide valves are not or only partly open | During operation, open stop valves / 
 slide valves completely
Opposite sense of rotation | Check the rotation direction
Suction pipeline or shaft seal is leaky | Retighten, check shaft seal
Air in suction and pressure system | Open vant valve
Liquid level in tank too low | Fill tank to necessary liquid level
Delivery too low | Stop valves / side valves are not or only partly open | During operation open stop valves / side valves completely
Wrong viscosity of the fluid pumped | Check recommended specifications
Pressure - relief valve leaks. | Check pressure - relief valve
Geodetic suction head too high | Check under pressure on the suction side via the connected 
 pressure vacuum gauge. Increase liquid level in tank loweriing of pump
Motor speed too low | Check speed, voltage frequency
Air separation time in operating tank too short | Provide for better air separation in the operating tank 
 balance pipelines must end below the oil level of the tank
Liquid level in tank too low | Fill tank to the necessary liquid level
Pump operates noisily | Suction pipeline or shaft seal is leaky | Retighten flange, check shaft seal
Air in suction and pressure system | Open vent valve on the pump pressure side until air has 
 escaped. Close valve again
Wrong viscosity of the fluid pumped | Clicck recommended specifications
Pressure - relief valve leaks | Check pressure - relief valve
Irregular delivery | Geodetic suction head too high | Check under pressure on the suction side via the connected 
 pressure vacuum gauge. Increase liquid level in tank lowering of pump
Air separation time in operating tank too short | Provide for better air separation in the operating tank. 
 Balance pipelines must end below the oil level of the tank
Liquid level in tank too low | Fill tank to the necessary liquid level
Rate of flow in the suction and outlet pipeline too high | The rate of flow in the suction pipeline must not exceed 1.4 
 m/s and in the outlet pipeline 3 m/s as a maximum
Pump speed higher than rated | Measure the pump speed
Wrong viscosity of the fluid pumped | Check recommended 
 smcdaflons
Pressure - relief valve leaks | Check pressure /qyejaot valve
Air separation time in operating tank too short | Provide 
 fopptter air 
 separation in the operating tank, balance pipelines must end below the oil 
 level of the tank
Pump gets too warm | Wrong viscosity of the fluid pumped | Check recommended 
 specifications
Pressure - relief valve leak | Check pressure relief valve
Liquid level in tank too low | Fill tank to the necessary 
 liquid level
Delivery pressure too high | Adjust specified delivery 
 pressure via the pressure relief valve. Pump outlet pressure must not be 
 exceeded
Damaged ball bearing | Replace ball bearing
Pump is seized | Foreign bodies in the pump | Dismount the pump, remove 
 foreign bodies and polish damaged points with oilstone. Check suction filter 
 or strainer respectively
Damaged ball bearing | Replace ball bearing
Motor overload | Wrong viscosity of the fluid pumped | Check recommended specifications
Pump speed higher than rated | Measure the pump speed
Delivery pressure too high | Adjust specified delivery pressure via the pressure relief 
 valve pump outlet pressure must not be exceeded
Delivery pressure drops | Pressure spring of relief valve is fatigued | Install new pressure spring
Pressure relief valve dose not open | Pressure spring is not or insufficiently pretensioned | Turn adjusting screw to the right until the required 
 operating pressure has been reached pressure
Pressure relief valve dose not close | Pressure spring is not or insufficiently pretensioned | Turn adjusting screw to the right until the required 
 operating pressure has been reached
Pressure relief valve knocks | Pressure - relief valve knocks | Check overpressure with the pressure valve closed re-adjust 
 valve, opening pressure 10 % above operating pressure
